title: Home-Site Lease Deposit, Application Fee and Household Limits
content:
Under the Home-Site Lease, the security deposit is a multiple of the contracted monthly site rent, the residency application (background screening) fee is charged for each adult applicant aged 18 or over and is non-refundable, the site rent covers a set number of adult occupants, each further registered adult carries a monthly occupant charge, and no home may be occupied by more than a set number of persons of any age.

| Lot class | Security deposit (months of contracted rent) | Application fee per adult (USD) | Adults covered by the site rent | Charge per further adult (USD per month) | Most persons of any age |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 1.0 | 50.00 | 2 | 25.00 | 4 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 1.0 | 50.00 | 2 | 25.00 | 4 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 1.0 | 50.00 | 2 | 30.00 | 6 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 1.0 | 50.00 | 2 | 30.00 | 6 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 1.0 | 50.00 | 2 | 30.00 | 6 |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 1.5 | 50.00 | 2 | 35.00 | 6 |

### Questions the schedule answers

**How large is the deposit on a Lakefront Multi-Section site?** One and a half months of the contracted monthly site rent (1.5); on every other lot class it is one month (1.0).

**How many adults does the site rent include?** Two on every lot class. A third adult registered on a Standard Single-Section site carries 25.00 a month; on a Lakefront Multi-Section site, 35.00 a month.

**Does the occupancy limit count children?** Yes. The limit is persons of any age: four on the single-section lot classes and six on the multi-section lot classes.

*Hypothetical figures.* A household of three adults applying for a Greenbelt Multi-Section site is charged three application fees of 50.00, a total of 150.00; once living there, the one adult beyond the two included carries 30.00 a month.
